note: One record per public claim (Roadmap III rule 7.5.10). claims.claim: A course exported as a Thin Common Cartridge validates against the Common Cartridge v1.3 schemas and the Thin Common Cartridge profile's rules.
claims.scope: the four built-in courses recorded in English and Spanish, with and without the notes for instructors (16 cartridges), as built by the course builder's and the kit's export; the fifth course (The Solar System and the Sun) and the two edited courses are NOT in the recorded run
claims.method: tools/cartridge-validate.mjs ran xmllint against the CC v1.3 manifest and web link schemas and the profile checker (tools/cartridge-profile.mjs) over every cartridge; tests/commonCartridge.test.js runs the checker in CI and fails when a cartridge differs from the recorded run
claims.evaluator: the project's own tools; the schemas are 1EdTech's
claims.limitations: A valid manifest is not an import: the 1EdTech valid test sets and conformance testing are member-only and were not used, and the schemas are not committed (their licence needs a registration with 1EdTech), so CI checks the profile's rules and the digests of the recorded run, and the schemas themselves only run on a machine that has them. The schema run has not been repeated since Prompt 206 added a built-in course and edited two: until a person with the schemas runs tools/cartridge-validate.mjs --write, the recorded verdict covers the earlier cartridges only (D-R10-206-04).

anchors.text: A manifest that validates is not an import.

claims.method: tests/planetsCloseout.test.js recomputes the fitted periods, the Laplace combination with its uncertainty, the light times and scale-model lengths, and the emission temperatures along an orbit from the kernels; the central-experiment and lesson walks run each lesson's own validators in a browser
claims.limitations: Internal validation against the project's own kernels; the Spanish has not been read by a fluent reader; no student has used the investigations; the three investigations the roadmap named and the project did not build are recorded in D-R10-206-01.
